title: console: three sites still teach or pin a declared index's bare `unique: true`, which `@objectstack/spec` refuses since objectstack#22103 (the help text leads a user into a save-time 422)
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with named landing sites and a measured reach.** Filed by the objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#18549, `session_01GV6oYwgc1kWiUCb1YaprQ7`) as the follow-up that objectstack-ai/objectstack#22103's ACCEPT (`6043719207`) and contract review (`6043697519`) named for its merge. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## What changed upstream

objectstack-ai/objectstack#22103 merged at 2026-10-08T02:32Z as `ef1fcb26a2` (closing objectstack-ai/objectstack#5082). It implements ADR-0120's protocol-18 items:
- a declared index's `unique` is now `false | 'global' | 'organization'`. Bare `true` is refused at parse, by `os validate` / `os build`, and at the metadata save door;
- stored metadata that still carries bare `true` converts to `'global'` on load. That conversion builds the same physical index.

A field-level `unique: true` is unchanged and stays valid.

**Reach, measured upstream** (#5082's dev report `6042104916`, H1): the runtime save door (`saveMetaItem`, behind `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/:name`) answers `422 INVALID_METADATA` for an object whose declared index carries bare `unique: true`, and stores nothing. The control, `'global'`, stores one row.

## The three sites (read on objectui `main` `4e7dd56ed1`)

1. **`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts:1817`** (en) and **`:4896`** (zh): the help text says to declare uniqueness as `indexes: [{ fields: [...], unique: true }]`. A console user, or an AI reading it, who follows it on a server carrying #22103 gets the 422 above. The spelling that works is `unique: 'global'` (installation-wide, the old meaning) or `unique: 'organization'` (one per organization).
2. **`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/EmbeddedItemEditor.indexFallback.test.tsx:166-172`**: a control asserts `IndexSchema.safeParse({ fields: ['c'], unique: true }).success === true`, and its comment names objectstack#5082. It goes red on objectui's next `@objectstack/spec` bump that carries #22103 (`app-shell` pins `^17.6.0`).
   - The case at `:211-215` opens a legacy `unique: true` index. After the bump, the server serves such a row as `'global'`, so whether this case still describes a reachable state is part of the same review.
3. **`packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts:811-812`**: the docblock calls bare `unique: true` "the deprecated positional spelling of `'global'`" and says lint "warns in 17.x". It is now refused, not deprecated.

## Reader who acts

objectui's next `@objectstack/spec` bump, which carries #22103, in whichever lane triage routes it to. That PR goes red on site 2 regardless, so the three ride together. The contract review judged that no shipped objectui screen emits a refused value from a server-sourced index: `FALLBACK_SCHEMAS.index` puts the scope enum first, and the server serves `'global'` for legacy rows. The defect is the teaching text and the stale pins.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, repo-scoped, closed included:
- 「declared index bare unique true refused protocol 18 console help text i18n indexes unique global」 → 2 hits; neither is this.
- 「EmbeddedItemEditor indexFallback test IndexSchema safeParse unique true still accepted spec bump」 → 68 hits; none is this (#4644 is the field "Indexed" toggle, a different key).

Dedupe words: `declared index bare unique true refused` · `indexFallback still ACCEPTED unique true` · `i18n indexes unique true help text`
